verdict.rationale: Dynadot has first-party transfer-in pages, including bulk transfer and API transfer commands. The transfer page says transfers include a "1-year renewal", which hints at what happens to registration time, but none of the cited material documents the auth/EPP code flow, transfer status tracking, or the transfer price. Missing for 10: documented EPP/auth-code steps, transfer status tracking, explicit transfer cost, explicit statement that remaining registration time is preserved, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, transferring domains IN is documented and honest — EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, what the transfer costs, and what happens to remaining registration time

citations.quote: Move your domains to Dynadot in minutes. Enjoy free privacy, 1-year renewal, and 24/7 support.
Transfer your domains from another provider to Dynadot all at once.
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands.
